marco (runtime): Heads up — noticed a regression in tonight's canary. p95 generation latency for small batches (B=1-4) is ~+30%. Appears correlated with yesterday's autotune heuristics change. Anyone seen this?

deploy-bot: Canary deploy 2026-03-17T02:12:34Z completed: commit sha abcdef1 (autotune-heuristics).
alicia (runtime): I started a quick profile on a canary VM. We see a lot of on-demand kernel compilations during steady traffic — basically a compile storm when small requests hit.
alicia (runtime): Sample from perf tracer:```
compile_time_ms  count
  28.3          142   // small-matmul_variant_x86_q4_1
  31.1           97   // fused_attention_small_seq
cache_miss_rate: 0.72
```
ben (infra): looks like the autotune change changed the kernel selection key, which invalidated cached kernels on nodes. That would make kernels recompile and also prevent reuse of the persistent KV cache for some requests.
carol (eng-sre): CI alert: job end2end-latency-small-bs failed in nightly: p95 +28% vs baseline. See https://ci.internal/teams/infra/1234 (link). Marking as high-sev for release gating.
marco (runtime): So two issues: wrong kernel pick for small batch sizes, and cache invalidation leading to extra work. Can we bisect to the PR?
alicia (runtime): Bisect points to PR #4321 (autotune heuristics: prefer newer kernels for micro-bench wins). The change added kernel_variant_id to the cache key. That was intended for correctness, but for B<=4 it picks a different low-latency codepath that doesn't use the persistent KV cache.
ben (infra): Recompiling is cheap-ish but at scale it spikes compile queue and increases tail latency while KV cache rebuilds.
dave (ml infra): I have a quick patch that keeps the previous kernel selection for seq_len<64 and B<=4 while retaining the new key for other cases. Will push a branch for review.
marco (runtime): Can we revert the autotune change to stop the regression ASAP?
alicia (runtime): I'll test a revert in staging now. Command I'm running:```
git revert --no-commit abcdef1
./scripts/deploy-canary --image=staging-autotune-revert
```
deploy-bot: Canary rollback initiated for canary group alpha.
ben (infra): If revert fixes it, we should still follow up with a smaller autotune test: run targeted autotune on representative HW (A100 and V100 mixes) instead of fleet-wide. Full autotune pass is expensive.
alicia (runtime): Agreed. Also adding a change to keep kernel_variant_id out of the persistent-kv-key for small-batch codepaths so we don't thrash the cache.
carol (eng-sre): Keeping this as rollout-blocker. Will un-block only once nightly canary p95 is within 5% of baseline for three consecutive runs.
marco (runtime): Thanks all — tracking in internal issue #987. Alicia, ping here when staging revert results are in and attach flamegraphs.
alicia (runtime): Will do. Early staging numbers show p95 back to baseline after revert. I'll post detailed flamegraphs in ~30m. :thumbsup:
